reuse.why: Calls the existing shared getExpectedScheduleAmount, which the server schedules code already uses for the same rule.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the field is one call to the shared helper.

placement.why: The field is derived in scheduleModel.toExternal, the API shaping layer, with the rule kept in #shared/schedules.

scope.why: Only the API type, its mapping and a focused test change.

maintainability.why: Simple derived field tied to the same definition the server uses, with tests for range, number and missing amounts.
